Apparently having multilple jobs is now… fraud.

Not bad performance.
Not missing deadlines.
Not doing terrible work.

No — the real crime is… being efficient.

In this video, we break down the newest LinkedIn panic trend: “job stacking” (aka overemployment) — where companies are now trying to detect if you might have… a second job.

You know, instead of just looking at your actual work.

We go through the posts, the comments, the “leadership takes,” and the absolute meltdown happening over the idea that employees might not be 100%
title: THE END OF BEING OVER EMPLOYED!
